title: Pressure
simplified_paragraphs: 我今年来中国学习汉语，这是我第一次出国。陌生的环境让我很紧张，因为我哪儿都不熟悉。学汉语不容易，每个月都要准备考试，这让我压力很大，状态也很差，经常丢三落四。后来，我的同学和老师一起帮助我，他们建议我要劳逸结合。我选择了练瑜伽。运动真的可以减压，出汗让我觉得非常舒服。我还因为运动，结识了很多朋友。我还把这些新朋友逐一介绍给我的同学。我要把我的方法告诉大家，或许可以帮助更多的人。
traditional_paragraphs: 我今年來中國學習漢語，這是我第一次出國。陌生的環境讓我很緊張，因為我哪兒都不熟悉。學漢語不容易，每個月都要準備考試，這讓我壓力很大，狀態也很差，經常丟三落四。後來，我的同學和老師一起幫助我，他們建議我要勞逸結合。我選擇了練瑜伽。運動真的可以減壓，出汗讓我覺得非常舒服。我還因為運動，結識了很多朋友。我還把這些新朋友逐一介紹給我的同學。我要把我的方法告訴大家，或許可以幫助更多的人。

english_paragraphs: I came to China this year to study Chinese. It’s my first time abroad, and the unfamiliar surroundings made me nervous because I didn’t know my way around. Learning Chinese isn’t easy. I have to prepare for an exam every month, which puts me under a lot of pressure. I haven’t been doing well and often forget things. Later, my classmates and teachers helped me. They suggested that I balance studying with rest, so I decided to try yoga. Exercise really does relieve stress, and working up a sweat makes me feel great. I’ve also made many friends through exercise, and I introduced each of them to my classmates. I want to share what worked for me with everyone. Maybe it can help more people.
english_full: I came to China this year to study Chinese. It’s my first time abroad, and the unfamiliar surroundings made me nervous because I didn’t know my way around. Learning Chinese isn’t easy. I have to prepare for an exam every month, which puts me under a lot of pressure. I haven’t been doing well and often forget things. Later, my classmates and teachers helped me. They suggested that I balance studying with rest, so I decided to try yoga. Exercise really does relieve stress, and working up a sweat makes me feel great. I’ve also made many friends through exercise, and I introduced each of them to my classmates. I want to share what worked for me with everyone. Maybe it can help more people.
